༄༅/ /'gro mgon ras pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa'o/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'gro mgon ras pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa'o//

"$ ༄༅// na mo gu ru/ sprin bral sgrib med 'od gsal chos sku'i nam mkha' la// dag pa bde chen longs sku nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar// sna tshogs sprul sku'i 'od kyis skal ldan mun pa sel// sku gsum bdag nyid dpal ldan ras pa'i zhabs la 'dud// dpal ldan ras pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa la spyir bsam gyis mi khyab rjod kyis mi langs yang*/ mdor bsdus na gnyis te/ rigs dang 'brel pa bla ma btsal ba'i yon tan dang*/ nyams su blangs pas grub rtags dang 'brel pa'i yon tan no// dang po la gnyis ste/ 'jig rten pa'i yon tan dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos zhus pa'o// dang po ni khong gi yab kyi yul gtsang gi gshung pa drug gong ba yin bar gda'/ gdung rus ni dru gu lags/ yab yum gnyis yod tsam na/ nu bo dbus su tshong la song ba ma log nas/ khong gi yab rtsang pa dpal grags de la mkhar btsan po gcig yod pa las/ pha spun rnams kyis btsong dbang la ster nas/ mkhar rming du chu bkyes nas bsgyel bar gda'/ de nas grogs gtsang pa klu grags dang gnyis/ tshos tang 'ga' bkal nas dbus su nu bo tshol du 'ong bas/ dol yi tshong dus mer mar du nu bo dang phrad/ der khong la byon chang mang po drangs/ de nas 'dren po gcig la rta tshan can sus kyang mi thub pa gcig de nub bos de zhon nas/ mi kun gyis 'di ma zhon mi thub pa gcig yin byas pa la/ khong chang gis bzi bas/ ngas ci dka' zer nas brgyugs pas/ lcang gseb tu khyer nas lcang ma la mgo brdabs nas shi bar gda'/ de nas khong gi yab te/ dbye'i glang shor re'i gser kar 'ongs nas tshong byas/ der gtsang mo btsun chung ma dang 'dug nas mos chang btsos khos tshong byas nas/ der lo 'ga' bsdad par gda'/ de nas yul yar lung yid phyos nya mo gzhung du 'ongs nas/ khu rje snying po la gnas po bcol/ tshong la sogs pa byas nas khang gzhi phab par gda'/ der khong ma bu lnga bu mo gcig dang ming sring drug yod pa'i/

rin po che chung ltag lags skad/ de yang bu che shos kyi ming 'byur grags bya ba yin ba mon la song bas shi skad/ de 'og 'byung skyabs/ de 'og glog 'byung*/ de 'og khong yin ba 'byung rgyal bya ba yin gsungs chung shos gra po bya ba yin/ sring mo skya rgyal ba yin gsungs/ khong sku mched yo ka mi dgod drag rtsal can sha stag yin bar 'dug /rin po che 'di dang po nas rang rgyud pa yin bar gda'/ byis pa'i dus su ri la ra lug 'tshor song tsa na/ dgong mo ra lug ded nas khyim du 'ongs dus su/ khong gar bzhud bzhud du 'ja' zug cing byung ba kun gyis mthong bar gda'/ khong gi yab kyang dad pa can gcig yin gsung*/ de'i rten 'brel chos byed dang rnal 'byor pho mo'i sten bskyags byed pas/ dus lan gcig rnal 'byor pa bzang po gcig khong gi can du 'byon bas/ khong gi yab la/ khyod kyi bu chung ltag 'di nga la slang zer skad/ de ci lags byas pas/ bu 'di la bu med gser gyi rna cha can mang pos 'khor zhing 'dug /de dha ki ma yin pas byis pa 'dis chos byas na/ rnal 'byor pa bzang po 'ong ba yin zer skad/ der khong gis ma byin bar 'dug /bla ma btsal ba'i yon tan ni/ de nas 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa rjes su dran/ 'khor ba la skyo ba skyes nas/ rje btsun zangs ri ba de khong gi yab kyi slob dpon yin bas/ lo bcu dgu la zangs rir bros pa dang*/ chos sgor zhugs nas rnal 'byor pa byas par gda'/ de nas rje btsun bro sgoms ras pa la jo mo rnal 'byor ma'i dbang bskur dang*/ rdo rje gtum po'i bsgrub thabs dang*/ bde mchog snyan rgyud dang*/ thun 'jog che ba la sogs pa/ dpal nā ro pa'i thabs lam kyi gdam ngag mang du gnangs nas bsgos pas/ khong brtson 'grus che bas/ gos ras rkyang gis dros/ sems la bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams nyin mtshan 'da' ba byung bar gda'/ de dus khong grogs mched gnyis yod pa chos sgor zhugs pas khong la ras chen du mtshan de nas btags par gda'/

grogs de la ras chung ba gsungs ngo*// de nas lo lnga tsam lon ba na rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ sang phod de kho bo yi ro kho bos ri la skyel ba yin gsung pa la/ khong na so gzhon bas de'i don ma go gsungs/ de'i phyir lo zhang ston phyugs gcig gis khong la chags lam kyi dbang bskur zhus pas des rkyen nas sku bsnyung bar gda'/ de'i dus su bla ma zhang sum tog pa mkhar rtsar bzhugs pas khong gdan 'dren du btangs pas/ rin po che phag mo grub pa dang mjal/ 'tshogs chos nyi ma 'ga' gsan gsungs/ de nas zangs rir gtig po brag la bzhud/ der bsnyung nad kyis gtugs pa dang*/ khong rnams kyis da res sku khams skyon nam mi skyon zhus pas/ da res kyi dbang bskur de min na kho bos bla ma rje btsun ba'i sku tshe'i tshad thub pa yin ba la/ da res bar chad byung ba yin bas dha ba yin gsungs/ de nas rin po ches khong gi mchan du dbu bcugs nas/ da ngas gdam ngag kyang ma lon nyams myong yang ma rdzogs pa dang su la brten/ ci tsug bgyi zhes zhus shing bshums pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas khyod la bka' brgyud zin par 'ong ba gcig ngas shes pa la/ bla ma rje btsun ba'i lugs kyis/ dang po nas gdam ngag thams cad mod cal kyi mi mdzad pa yin bas/ nges shes thob nas gdam ngag dus gcig bstan pa yin gsungs/ da khyod rgya sgom la rten dang nga'i gdam ngag thams cad kho la yod pa yin/ bu khyod rang gi slob dpon yang yin bas/ legs par 'ong gsung ba la/ khong thugs rgyal che bas rje btsun ras chung gi slob ma 'di rnams yod pa la/ rgya sgom sngar slob dpon yin yang*/ nga brgyud pa mar la bda' ba'i don med dgongs nas/ dol na yar byon nas mtshur ston sgom brtan la gtugs/ phag mo dpyal lugs dang*/ rdo rje gtum po'i las kha tshar dang*/ ras chung gi bzhi chos dang*/ sems phyogs kyi gdam ngag la sogs pa mang du gsan gsungs/ de nas rang yul du byon nas gtel dkyus brag la bsgoms pas nub gcig gi rmang lam na/

rje btsun ma zhal gnyis ma g.yung drung ris dang bcas pa zhal gzigs gsungs/ der lo 'ga' tsam bzhugs pas nad pa la phyogs pa la phan thogs pa yang byung gsungs/ de nas dmyal du byon nas yo ga do rug tsang ston kon ne yab sras la/ bram ze chen po'i chos mdzod chos drug dang snying po skor drug dang*/ gnod sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul la sogs pa bstan srungs kyang mang du zhus par gda'/ phyag rgya chen po be'u bum sngon po la sogs mang du gsan/ 'jam dpal gsang ldan dang*/ drag po sum sbrel la sogs pa bsgrub thabs kyang mang du gsan bar gda'/ zhi byed snyan rgyud la sogs pa gdam ngag kyang mang du gsan bar gda'/ ma jo mo se mo gnam yan kyi gzim sa na tshur la mkha' 'gro ma su ka si ti ma byon ba'i zhal yang gzigs/ de nas za chu 'dus na mar byon bas/ grub thob dha rma shes rab bya ba/ rin po che sgom ba'i slob ma yin zer ba/ rlung dbu mar tshud pas/ 'od gsal rgyud chad med par gcig dang mjal nas/ chos kyi dri rtogs dang byin rlabs kyang zhus gsungs/ de nas sos ka yur ma ran tsam na/ dmyal ba stod na yar byon nas nyin gcig 'dzar cung ma ran tsam na/ yur mi 'ga' yi 'dzar ba la skrur dgongs nas/ grog phug gcig tu bsgoms zhing bzhugs tsam na/ bud med gcig rgyab na sel po gcig khur lag na bya bo gcig thogs nas 'dzar ba skyel du song*/ de'i phyir na phar khyi 'ga' thal ba yang gzigs nas/ de ci yin dgongs nas/ yar bzhengs nas bltas pas de kho na bzhin gda' skad/ de nas tshur yar lung su byon pa'i lam kar dbye ba'i khar gong ser por/ bla ma rje sgoms zhig po'i chags phyir zhag bca' bcur 'brangs nas/ slob dpon bye ma la'i rdzogs pa chen po snyan rgyud gsan bar gda'/ de nas yar lung su lo 'ga' bzhugs pa la/ dge sbyor dmar bar ma byung bas/ da yongs rang yul rna bas mi thos pa'i yul gcig tu 'gro dgos dgongs nas/

ngams shod smad gang bar ce grong na mar byon nas/ dbye chung skor der glang yul du slob dpon thod pa bsam grub la/ ma jo mo lab sgron kyi gdam ngag kun zhus par gda'/ de nas dwags po la 'drims nas/ rkong po yi lo sar la byon nas/ bla ma rtsang pa mnga' ris pa dang mjal nas/ phyag rdor gos dmar can dang*/ rtag pa tshod 'dzin dang*/ rdo rje legs pa'i bsgrub thabs byang bu nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la sogs pa'i gdam ngag mang du gsan bar gda'/ de nas spo bo na tshur byon bas/ dge bshes dmyal ba jo sras dang mjal nas khong gis yi ge ston cing chos zhus pas thugs la btags/ phag mo chos drug la sogs pa'i dpe cha yang mang po der bris par gda'/ 'jam dpal pa la pa tra la sogs pa'i yig sna mang po yang dag zhus par gda'/ khyad par du mal jo lo tsa'i mgon po lcags spar can zhus pas gnang nas zhal yang gzigs gsungs/ de lo la zhus pas khyod dang las 'brel yod par 'dug /da khyod kyi sdongs grogs byed pa yin gsungs/ de dus bsgrubs rogs gcig byas pas kyang nus pa thon/ phyis khong gis gsung pa bzhin du byung gsungs/ de nas khong gi yum gyis khong tshol du ro zan nag po btangs nas byung ba dang*/ dbus su 'gro dgos da ma song na ma rgan lcebs zer nas nga btangs pa yin zer ba la/ nga mi 'gro khyod rang yar la song byas pas/ khyod mi 'gro na ngas khyod kyi mgo de bcad nas 'khyer ba yin zer/ khong gis de sngon byis pa'i dus kyi gtam yin da khyod kyi nga mi thub byas lo// 'on kyang 'o skol zas nor med par dbus su song bas mis 'khams logs zer nas 'dod mi med pas/ da sa smad nas nor tshol la 'o skol lhan du mar 'gro yis byas nas kho brid par gda'/ de nas jo sras dang*/ khong sku mched gnyis dang grogs mched gsum tsha ba sgang la byon bas/ sku bsod bzang po byung bar gda'/ de nas smar khams su byon nas/

chos zhu ba mang du byung*/ dbang bskur yang mang du mdzad gsungs/ de nas bu 'bor smad na/ mi rus pa 'bu bya ba yod pa'i yul du byon nas/ sku bsod dpag tu med pa byung*/ gnam lcags gra pa'i dpon khong la zhus nas/ sngags pa bzhi bcus bskor re tsam kyi gra pa yang yod par gda'/ de nas 'bu yul 'gongs smad du 'gong po nang du 'khrug pa shor bas khong gis dum mdzad nas/ da lta yang khong gi gsung la brten skad/ de nas kam po gnas nang na rin po che dus gsum mkhyen pa bzhugs pa la/ chos zhu rgyu nga la med phyag gcig 'tshal ba dang*/ kam po gnas nang na ltad mo gcig lta ba la/ 'bu yul 'gongs nas yar byon bas/ nam mkha' 'ja' yis 'khrigs nas byung bar gda'/ 'di ci yin zhus pas/ da yul 'dir 'ong mi 'gru ba yin gsungs/ de nas gnas nang byon ba dang*/ kam po rdo rje dpal rtsegs kyis rkya mi lnga ru byas nas chu skor rtsa nas bsu ba mdzad par gda'/ de nas gnas nang ba'i 'khor kun kyis bla ma la chos zhu rgyu med zhal lta zer ba de khyed i yin zer skad/ der rin po che dang mjal nas/ dang po ni dad pa yang de tsam du ma skyes/ 'dris shing grub thob rtsod med du 'dug dgongs nas/ da khong la dge sbyor gyi pu tag gcig gcod dgos dgongs nas der bzhugs gsungs/ nyams su myong ba grub rtags dang 'brel pa'i yon tan ni/ de nas 'khor rnams spangs pa dang*/ gcig pur bzhugs nas bsgrub pa lo bdun du dbu sa la mi phabs pa'i dam bca' mdzad par gda'/ kol ti'i lha gnyer dbus cung gis sgom brgyags sbyar ba dang*/ bsgoms pas dge sbyor pu tag chod/ rin po che'i zhal nas dbus pa rnyed tshol gcig la/ khyod dang bka' gdams pa gnyis rnyed pa che'o gsungs/ bla ma ras chen khyod da lta skyid pa yin nam gsungs/ g.yeng zed med par gcig pur bsgoms pas chog /sang tsam na g.yeng zed kyi 'dug dbang mi ster ba dang*/

khyod la gyod gcig yod gsung skad/ de khong gis mkhyen par gda' bas shin tu mad par byung gsungs/ gnas nang du dbang bskur gcig gi gral du/ rje dus sum mkhyen pa yang rnal byon/ khong yang rnal byon pa'i snang ba la/ bla ma bde mchog tu gzigs gsungs/ yang gnas nang du slob dpon bka' gdams pa'i chags phyir dpon slob kun rje rin po che la phyag 'tshal du bzhud pa'i dus su/ rlangs stengs na phar la phyin kar/ lam du nyi ma ri'i rked smad tsam du/ rje btsun zhal gcig ma'i dbu thog na rin po che bzhugs pa zhal gzigs pas/ spyan chab g.yo ba tsam gyi mos gus khyad par can byung*/ da res rin po che dang mi 'jal bar 'dug dgongs tsam na/ de dus khong tre na bzhud pas ma mjal gsungs/ de nas da logs su dgon pa 'dzin bas/ 'tshogs pa'i dben pa bsten pa dga' dgongs nas slobs dpon bka' gdams pa'i drung du lo gsum tsam bsgoms gsungs/ der slob dpon bas 'phags pa ras chen khyod/ rab tu byung dang gzhan la phan ba yin gsung ba dang*/ gnas nang du rin po ches de skad gsung ba la/ nga rang gi co yun gyi bla ma zangs ri ba tsam bsgom rtan tsam byung na des chog byas nas rab tu ma byung*/ da khyed kyi kyang de skad gsung bas da cis kyang rab tu 'byung dgos gsung bar gda'/ de nas dgung lo sum cu rtsa bdun la/ mkhan po dge bshes mo gom pa dang*/ slob dpon bka' gdams pa rnam pa gnyis la/ bzang rta re re phul nas bsnyen rdzogs mdzad par gda'/ de tsam na nga rab tu byung ba yang phyis dgongs pa yang byung gsungs/ yang slob dpon bka' gdams pa'i drung du/ sbas dung rdo rje rin chen bya ba gcig gi drung du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i dus su/ kho mig nam mkha' la ce re lta zhing 'dug pas/ de ci'i don dgongs nas khong gis kyang yar gzigs pas/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbu thog na rin po che bzhugs pa gzigs gsungs/

yang slob dpon bka' gdams pa'i dbang bskur gcig gi gral du/ khams bdag bskyed rims mdzad pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha bskyed pa la sogs pa ci lta ba bzhin mkhyen pa dang*/ byin rlabs 'bebs pa'i dus su/ si 'du ra'i dkyil 'khor sting na/ dha ki ma lcags kyi mda' gzhu can bzhis/ khong bdag gi dmigs pa gar gtad du dang zha 'ong 'ong byed pa gzigs gsungs/ de'i dus su byin rlabs gar gtad la 'ong bar gda' gsungs/ des phyis bla ma la zhus pas de ka tsug yin gsung skad/ de rnams kyi lo rgyus rnams mkhan po la bshad pas/ mkhan pos slob dpon bka' gdams pa la bshad pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ 'phags pa ras chen da ni khyod mngon shes kyang bshad yang gsung nas bka' bkyon mang po mdzad gsungs/ mkhan po ni shin tu dad pas/ khong mkhan bu yin te dbang bskur yang zhus gsungs/ de nas rin po che sa stod na yar la bzhud nas/ zla rngol du kar ma na chags phab zer bas/ sngon khong dbus su bzhud gsungs nas/ nga la yang dbus su dga' ba yin 'deng ngam gsung ba la/ dbus pha yul yin bas ma song ba de yin/ da yang khong dbus su bzhud na yang zhal mi mjal bas/ phyag gcig 'tshal du 'gro dgos dgongs nas/ dpe cha kun sa smad du bzhag /rin po che dbus su ma bzhud na ni/ dpe cha yar len nas khong can du bsdad pas chog bsam nas/ yar la phyag 'tshal du 'ongs/ de'i lam kar gsu shod 'dzer chu ru dkon mchog bla ma'i dbang bskur mdzad pa'i dus su/ rje btsun ma zhal bzur nas gda' ba gzigs skad/ da kho yi dam tshigs la skyon yod pa yin zer bas/ nga yang khams bag tsam ma bde gsungs/ de nas kar mar rin po che dang mjal nas lo gsum bzhugs par gda'/ gdam ngag gi rting pa thams cad tshar bar zhus gsungs/ dbus su i bzhud zhus pas/ nga na ning tsa na ning de yin gsung bas/ dbus su bzhud pas rta shod rna rgyang du bskyal nas/ sa smad du bzhud par gda'/

de nas smar ka na dgon pa mdzad nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba bzhin mdzad gsungs/ 'bo bo drug tsa dkon mchog skyab kyi dbang bskur gcig mdzad pa'i dus su/ rin po che mdun kyi nam mkha' la byon bas/ nga mig 'khrul ba yin snyams nas/ mig btsums nas phyes nas bltas pas/ ja sun gcig thungs bar tsam gcig snang gsungs/ yon sgom grag ges gtum po'i tshogs mchod gcig zhus pa'i dus su/ bum pa'i nang du phyag na rdo rje sku chung la yan lag rags pa mtshon gang ba gcig gzigs gsungs/ khyag kyi nang du khyag dbal thar gyis dbang bskur gcig zhus pa'i dus su/ rin po che ber thul rkyang pa mnabs nas nam mkha' na tshur byon ba gzigs gsungs/ gnas nang du bla ma ro zan na ba'i rim 'gro byed pa'i mchod bral du/ rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa gcig gzigs gsungs/ de kho 'chi ba'i brda yin gsungs/ der shi nas ro bsregs thon ba dang/ bsten gtor bskyangs tsam na/ bsten gtor nang na las mgon bya rog gdong can sku stod yan chad gtor ma'i steng du bton ba zhal gzigs gsungs/ yang mdo lam dgon du phag mo dpon g.yog gsum zhal gzigs gsungs// bu 'bor du dpon rdo rje seng ge'i dbang bskur gcig mdzad pa'i dus su/ si dhu ra'i steng na/ rje btsun ma g.yu drung ris dang bcas pa zhal gzigs gsungs/ da res bkra shis par 'ong byas pas/ de tsug byung gsungs/ gnas nang du bzhugs pa dang gzhan du bzhud dgos pa'i dus su rdo rje dpal brtsegs kyis gzhan du bzhud pa la mi dgyes nas/ cho 'phrul btangs pa la do mod kho'i dbu thog tu phyag rdor bskyed pas/ sang tho rangs nam mkha' la rdo rje gtum pos zhabs g.yon pas dge bsnyen yi dbu thog tu bzhags nas snang ba zhal gzigs nas/ de nas cho 'phrul yang zhi gsungs/ dge bshes khang brtsegs ston pa la snyan rgyud zhu byas pas/ ngas khyed kyi slobs dpon mi 'ong khyed grub thob chen po lags gsung skad/

cis kyang gnang dgos zhus pas/ 'o na khyed kyis nga la skyabs 'gro gcig gnang bar zhu dgos gsungs nas/ khong gis skyabs 'gro gcig mdzad/ de nas khong gis da khyed la 'bul bas tshogs mchod dang bcas gyis gsungs/ do nub rje btsun ma nag mo phag zhal can/ shangs stengs na lcags kyi 'khor lo bskor ba gcig zhal gzigs pas/ chos shin tu gnyan ba gcig yin zin/ su dga' dga' dang su thod thod la bstan du mi rung ba'i brda yin gsungs/ yang zhe grong na bzhugs dus su/ mtshur phur rin po che 'das pa mkhyen/ mchod pa gcig mdzad pa'i tshogs gral du/ rin po che zhal gzigs nas/ thugs rje chen po'i nyi ma de/ bdag la nub pa e ci srid/ mjal bar zhu dang rin po che zhes pa'i mgur gsungs/ yang rlel 'ji na 'das mchod gcig gi dus su/ rin po che dang rje btsun ma zhal gzigs/ lar de 'dra la zad pa med gsungs/ yang sa smad du bon po btul ba'i dus su/ rje btsun mas phod gcig btsug pa gzigs/ da res bstan pa thon bar 'dug dgongs pa dang*/ thon bar byung gsungs/ de nas gnas nang du byon ba'i nub gcig /rje btsun ma sprin gyi gseb na sku stod byung nas snang ba/ de phan chad phyogs shin tu mun nag par gda'/ tshur ngos phyogs shin tu gsal bar gda' bas/ da de phyogs su 'gro mi rung ba yin gsung*/ yang gnas nang du nub gcig chos skyong phyin nas ngas phar ngos phyogs kun bde bar byas nas yod zer nas/ phyag g.yugs stangs mdzad nas/ khyod kyi bstan pa ngas bton zer/ khyod kyis bstod pa gcig kyang gyis dang zer bas/ der nye gnas bslangs nas pu tsa shom dang chos skyong la gtang rag gcig byed dgos byas nas/ gtang rag gtang*/ bdag ni rnal 'byor bsgrub pa po// khyod ni chos skyong dam tshigs can// ces pa'i bstod pa yang byas gsungs/ de'i dus su bon po'i dpon rta gor dge bsnyen la ā+oṃ bzhag pa yin zin gsungs/

de nas sngon rin po ches kyang dbus dga' ba yin gsung ba la/ da dbus skyes pa'i yul yin bas de mi gsung bar zhu/ gzhan gar song na'ang mi la phan zhus pas/ 'o na me 'dor zhing khams dkar ba yin/ chos byed kyi 'dug sa yang bzang*/ gzhan la phan par 'ong gis/ der song gsungs nas lung bstan gsungs/ de dus dbus su song na gzhan don 'di bas che bas 'ong bar 'dug gsungs/ de ci tsug lags zhus pas/ de nub dbus su 'dun pa btangs nas nyal bas/ rmang lam na rje btsun ma byi ru'i rgyan kyis brgyan pa sku la 'od zer 'phro bar gzigs gsungs/ de nas sa stod du bzhud dgongs nas rta gcig sems gcig bzang ba 'ga' sbyangs nas/ nye gnas kyang mang po ma khrid par bros nas 'ongs gsungs/ khong bzhud pa'i shul du sa smad kyi mi che chung med pa/ mi gces shi ba bzhin yo ngus par gda'/ de nas me 'dor na yar byon nas/ shal ba'i mi dpon rnams kyis yon bdag byas nas skungs su lo 'ga' bzhugs pa'i dus su/ khu tshur ri yi sa bdag gis bar chad bag tsam btangs pas/ 'khor 'ga' zhig na ba la/ khong gis gtor ma gcig mdzad pa las/ de dus su rje btsun ma rgyan can gcig phyogs thams cad du gar khyug khyug byed bya gcig gzigs pas/ de nas kho dbang du 'dus gsungs/ de nas kar mar rin po che'i gdan sa mdzad pa'i dus su/ rje btsun ma me dpung dang bcas pas gzigs pas/ gdan sa dar bar 'ong ba'i brda yin dgongs tsam na/ de nas lho stod kyi sde dgon thams cad kyis/ khong la gdan sa ba zhus/ rten gyi rab gnas dang sku bder bzhengs pa dang*/ mkhar lan thams cad mdzad nas/ shin tu gdan sa dar cing rgyas par byung gsungs/ de nas sum pa 'bro ldog gis rta gcig khyer bas/ ban dmag byas pa'i dus su/ rje btsun mas rus rgyan thogs nas gzigs/ bstan pa thon par 'dug dgongs pas/ de kho na ltar byung gsungs/ de nas ri to nang yan chad du byon nas/

gnas gzhi 'bul ba dang*/ nor ci snyed kar mar bshags nas/ yang shar du bzhud par gda'/ de'i dus su sku sa dgon par rab gnas cig gi dus su/ thugs rje chen po zhal gzigs gsungs/ de nas 'bri klong du dpon chos kyi grags pas gdan drangs nas/ gnas rgyan can kyi sna drangs pa'i khri ra can kyi 'bul ba byas/ rag tag de'i dgon phul nas de na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rje btsun ma rmog dang khrab gyon ba gzigs/ lho na 'khrug pa byung zin dgongs tsam na/ chos mgon lho nas 'khrug pa byung zer skad/ yang ku sa nas chos skyong yis 'bod pa dang*/ khyod sang phod zon gyis shig zer/ gsungs tsam na/ de nas lho'i rta pa brgya yis/ khong lho na gdan drangs pas/ de'i phyi lo phyag bsnyung nas de'u 'das byas gsungs/ de nas zla nyin du tsha bkab la chos khrims rtsod pa'i dus su/ khong sku khams ma bde der rje btsun mas rgyab bstan nas gzigs gsungs/ de ci tsug lags zhus pas dang por bzhes btangs/ de nas mdun ma blangs pas phrag dog 'ong ba'i brda yin gsungs/ de nas sku sman thang la byon pas nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' yis gang ba mi thams cad kyis mthong*/ de nas yang dgon ma tha na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ nub gcig gi rmang lam na/ rje btsun mas mchod rten ri rab med pa gcig bzungs nas snang ba gzigs gsungs/ de ci tsug lag zhus pas/ ri rab med pa shi tshe stod zad zer ba yin/ mchod rten bstan pa ni/ da res mi 'chi zer ba'i brda yin gsungs/ de res sku khams sman bar gda'/ yang kar mar 'das mchod gcig gis dus su/ bla ma'i bzhugs gdan la bla bre bris de la brten te bla ma dran nas mgur mang po mdzad/ de la brten nas bla mas dbu mdzad nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dha ki sprin dpung ltar gzigs/ lar 'das mchod 'di ngo mtshar che bar 'dug gsungs/ yang skungs su dbang bskur gcig kyi gral du rje btsun ma gnyis kyis rin po che'i sku brten nas snang ba gcig gzigs gsungs/

nga'i skye ba snga ma'i yi dam de rje btsun ma dbu bcad ma yin bar 'dug gsungs/ der nye gnas mchod btsun gyis/ khyed kyis yi dam zhal gzigs pa de/ skabs skabs gzigs pa lags sam/ dus rtag tu gzigs pa lags zhus pas/ 'o na chos kyi nang nas rgyal ba gcig bsgoms rgyal ba kun kyi ngang mi zer ram/ dgos pa yod na ngas nam 'dod kyis mthong gsungs/ ngas gzhan gyi yid dam de gang yin de mthong nas shes pa yang byung gsungs/ sgom chen ba su mthong ba yang*/ de'i nyams myong mthon dman de mthong bas shes gsungs/ yang kar ma na nub gcig rin po che chos gos rkyang pa mnabs byang phyogs su gzigs nas snang gsung*/ de ci tsug lags zhus pas/ byang ngos su bstan pa gcig rtsod dgos pa e ma yin gsungs/ de nas yun mi ring bar rag nam gyi rge ru ded nas dkon mchog rtsod dgos byung*/ de dus su rje btsun mas g.yu rdog thogs nas byung*/ da res bstan pa thon bar 'dug gsungs nas/ de ltar gsung ba bzhin du byung*/ de nas tshur lam du lda ma sa na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rmi lam na bka' brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad byon nas/ de rnams la rab byung 'ga' re snang*/ co yun shas che/ khyad par du te lo pa de gsal ba dang*/ de'i zhal nas/ nam mkha' la ni bya bzhin du/ thogs byed shes rab bzang po 'gro gsungs nas/ rim pa bzhin du lho nub kyi nam mkha' la bzhud nas thal/ khong yang bzhud pa la zla cung ma slebs gsungs/ yang bla ma dko 'o 'go lding mtshur phur 'bul ba bskur ba'i lam yogs la kar mar phyin/ mchod pa gcig byas khong sku khams bag tsam ma bde ba la/ rko bo'i bsam ba la gzhan don mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'di kun la sku bsnyung ba re ni 'phangs na/ khong gi bsnyung nad 'di rang la spo nyan na ci sto snyam tsa na/ der mkhyen nas grogs po khyod kyi sems bskyed de 'dra ba dgongs pa yin gsungs nas/

kho shin tu dad nas sa der phyag 'tshal/ 'bul ba byas chos zhus par gda'/ yang kar mar dpal ldan ma'i zhal gzigs nas/ nye gnas kun la lha mo'i bsgrub thabs slobs dang*/ 'di 'khor bar 'dug gsungs/ ngas gtor ma 'bul yang mi shes ste/ lan gnyis zhal mthong gsungs/ dpal ldan ma'i bsten gtor re re yang gyis gsungs nas/ dbus rtser bsten gtor byas so/ de nas dgung lo bdun cu'i lo la nang gcig gnyer pa la khyed rnams zhag 'ga' gar yang ma 'gro dang*/ sang gnangs 'di na mi khom ba gcig 'ong gsungs/ de nas gnyer pa yang gar ma song ci gsung ba yin snyam tsam na/ de nas zhag gsum na dbyar zla tha chung gi tshes bcu gcig la sku bsnyungs/ sman pa la bstan pas/ da res cis kyang mi phan bas kho bo 'gro ba yin/ sun ma byung nas lo gsum lon gsungs/ 'o na nged rnams ci ltar bgyi zhus pas/ gsol ba thob dang ngas khyed rnams 'dren par nus pa yin kyis/ lar chos dang mthun bar gyis dang yag par 'ong gis gsungs/ lar nga'i 'khor rnams la dge sbyor bskyang rgyu med pa cher med/ dge sbyor ngo shes pa shin tu mang*/ nga mi dgos pa yang 'ga' re yod gsungs/ de nas nga'i bla ma rnams kyang lho nub na phar bzhud par 'dug /nga yang de phyogs su 'gro dgos gsungs nas zhal de phyogs su gzigs/ de nas nya'i nyin par de la 'das gcig mdzad pas dung bus nas gra pa thams cad bsdus nas/ chos dang zhal da mang du gsungs/ de'i dus su nam mkha' 'ja' yis gang*/ bar snang 'od kyis gur phubs pa la sogs pa ltas dang*/ cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung bas/ thams cad kyis gsol ba drag por yang btabs/ rim 'gro'i rgyun yang drag por byas pas/ de nyin ma gshegs/ de nas khong gi zhal nas/ gsol 'debs shin tu gnad che ba yin/ nga da nang 'gro dus yin pa la khyed rnams kyis gsol ba btabs pas zhag 'ga' sdod pa yin/ lar nga la shi ba ma shi ba gnyis su med/ thams cad mnyam pa nyid chen po yin gsungs/

de nas zhag 'ga' na khong gi zhal nas/ bu tsa mig rtsa can g.yu'i zur phud yod pa gcig gis chang dong bya gang bzungs nas nga la lag mchod zhu zer/ de jo bo sngags kyi bdag po yin bar 'dug /khyed rnams kho la gtor ma phul la gsol ba thob dang khos lan gsum la nga ci zer nyan bar khas blangs pa yin gsungs so/ de yang kho bsur phyin pa yin tshod du gda'/ yang nyi shu gnyis kyi nyin par phyag gnyis thal mo lan 'ga' tsam sbyar bas/ de ci'i rgyu mtshan lags zhus pas/ de tso de rig pa skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i don la/ gom 'dres da byang ma dgos pas/ bla ma drin che snyam nas rin po che dran pa yin gsungs/ da 'o skol yang zhag gnyis tsam yin te/ de bar bla bo bya gsungs/ de nas nyi shu lnga'i tho rangs ka sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang dha ki dpag tu med pa sems can yi don la byon pa khyed kyi e mthong gsungs/ de nas nyi ma dros tsam na sprul pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor bsdogs nas kyang*/ gdung chos byas nas mchod khang nang na bzhugs pa la/ 'ga' res phyag mchod byed par mthong*/ 'ga' res chos gsung ba mthong ba la sogs pa mthong snang mang po byung bar gda'/ de nas ston zla ra ba'i tshes gsum la gdung bzhus pa'i nyin par yang*/ nam mkha' la nyi ma mang du shar ba dang*/ sa gzhi la ring srel gyis gang ba dang*/ bar snang 'ja' dang 'od kyi 'khrigs pa dang*/ sil snyan gyi sgra grag pa kun kyis thos pa ngo mtshar can mang po byung*/ gzhan yang sku'i rten la yi dam gyi lha sku mang po byon/ gsung gi rten la ljags dngos su byon/ thugs kyi rten la thugs dngos su byon ba lags so/ gzhan yang khong gi yon tan la mkhyen pa dang*/ gzigs pa dang*/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las la sogs pa bsam kyi mi khyab brjod kyis mi langs bas/ phyi rab rten kyi gang zag dad gus can rnams kyi don du/ rgya ras pa yis yi ger bkod pa'o/

rdzogs so// 'gro mgon ras chen rnam thar 'dis// 'gro ba mgon med ma lus rnams/ 'gro mgon nyid dang mjal nas ni// 'gro 'ong med pa'i don rtogs shog// / ༈ rin po che pong rag pa'i rnam par thar pa'o// bsam zhing srid par sku 'khrungs zhing*// yon tan rab 'byam brjod las 'das// 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig rje btsun gyi// zhabs kyi pad mo la btud de// gu ru pu nya badz+ra yi*/ rnam thar cung zad brjod par bya// mchog gi bla ma rin po che 'di/ skye ba snga ma la yul ma ga ta dang*/ rdo rje gdan dang bya rgod phung po gnyis kyi bar na/ sa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba'i blo gros zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs nas/ sdom pa gsum gyi rgyan dang ldan ba/ snying po'i don 'ba' zhig gis 'gro don rlabs po che mdzad pa cig yin gsungs/ da res 'di byon ba'i rgyu ni/ bsam zhing srid pa nye bar blangs nas/ 'gro don dpag tu med pa 'byung ba la dgongs pa yin gsung*/ 'bri rgyal dam pa chos phyugs su sku 'khrungs zhing*/ dgong lo lnga lon ba'i dus su yi ge dang klog la mkhas pa yin gsung*/ lo dgu dang bcu lon ba'i dus su/ gnyan lha gang rtsa pa'i yab sras la bde dgyes la sogs pa'i gsang sngags mang du gsan/ dgung lo bcu bzhi lon pa'i dus su sangs rgyas ras chen byon zer ba'i sgra phyogs med du grag /de'i dus su mtshan thos pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes pa byung*/ nub cig gi rmi lam na bud med bongs ring ba cig la/ bu mo mang po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i zhal nas/ khyod kyi bla ma dwags po sgom chung gi skye ba bla ma ras chen yin zer ba cig byung*/ de nas zhag bcu tsam lon ba'i dus su/ 'bogs sa 'ar sgang du rin po che ras chen dang mjal du 'byon ba'i dus su/ bla ma phyag na rdo rje'i ngo bo yin am snyam pa cig byung*/ de nas gnub stan tshul gyis/ dbang bskur zhus pa'i dus su/

khong yang zhor la bskrus pa'i/ byin rlabs phabs pa'i dus su/ steng 'og phyogs 'tshams dang bcas pa rje btsun ma'i dkyil 'khor yun ring du gsal ba gcig byung ba'i dus su bla ma ras chen gyi zhal nas/ mchod chung 'di yis nga'i dbang bskur thob pa yin gsung*/ de phyi chad pha dang bu phrad pa bzhin thugs la btags pa byung gsung*/ de nas sku dgon na sgom khrid bskyang ba'i dus su nam mkha' rten med pa las dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rang bzhin gyis bzhugs pa gcig snang*/ de la yun ring du bltas shing yengs pa'i ngang las/ sems kyi gnas lugs de nyid du rtogs pa lags pa na gsung*/ yang skyungs dgon pa na thang shing cig kyi rtsa ba na bsgom pa'i dus su/ thang shing de'i yal ga la rje dus gsum mkhyen pa dpag tu med pa gzigs kun kyi zhal nas ljags nyug nyug byed cing skye ba med pa'i don la goms par mi byed cing*/ dmigs pa sna tshogs la zhen par ma byed cig /de'i dus su ngo bo sgom du med pa te gsha' ma ba rtogs pa yin te/ kar ma na slob dpon gdan sa 'dzin du byon ba'i dus su/ rlel tu kar ma thang du yar 'gro tsam na dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin phung 'khrigs pa tsam gyis/ 'gro mgon la skor ba byed pa mthong*/ nga rang yang nam mkha' la gar byed cing 'gro nus pa snyams byung gsung*/ kar ma na phyin nas ldad phu na lha mo gnam rdzong na sgrub pa byed pa'i dus su/ dpal lha mos phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i lha tshogs/ jo bo sngags kyi bdag pos yon bdag byed gsung ba dang*/ khro bo'i rgyal po la khro mo mang pos bskor ba dang*/ gzhan yang mthong snang dpag tu med pa byung gsung*/ rje 'gro mgon ras chen pa de rnams zhus tsam na/ sgom chen ba'i lam rtags snang ba tsam yin te de la rlom sems ma byed gsung*/ 'gro mgon gyi zhal nas ras chung rtogs ldan yin yang yang gsung ba dang*/

gnyams chung yang yon tan can du grags pas/ gra pa kun kyis bkur cing byams par gyur pa yin gsung*/ yon sgom grags ge sa smad nas 'bul ba ched po dang byung gsung*/ chos skyong gi gtor dbang chen po zhus pa'i dus su/ grag go'i zhal nas grogs po rgyus med oṃ nga'i zla la gtor dbang zhus/ khyed kyi cha rkyen ngas 'don zer nas/ lung nod zhu ba'i dus su ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa dang ber nag can dang ma mgon gsum dus gcig zhal gzigs pa yin gsung*/ 'gro mgon yi zhal nas chos skyong 'di rnams gtad pa mi 'dug pas/ gro ge rgyu 'di rnams btang ba bas/ ras chung ba la phul gang gtong rgyu med pas/ chos skyong gi zhal mthong bar 'dug gsung*/ rje 'gro mgon ras chen 'das kar byon ba'i dus su 'gro mgon gyis khyod la bstan pa'i bdag po re ba yin gsung*/ de yang khyod kyi 'phrin las rgya che ba yin bu slob yang khyod kyi ring la nga'i bstan pa phyogs med du rgyas pa yin gsung*/ de'i dus su 'gro mgon dang tha dad med par bstan pa'i bdag po la sangs rgyas dpag tu med pas bskor ba cig mthong gsung 'gro mgon la zhus pa'i dus su/ bstan pa'i bdag po 'byung ba'i brda' yin gsung*/ 'gro mgon yongs su mya ngan la 'das nas gdung bzhu ba'i dus su/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin gtibs pa bzhin du gang bltas bltas su snang gsung*/ dag pa'i snang ba dpag tu med pa shar bas 'og min gyi gnas kyang 'di yin snyam pa byung*/ bla ma'i gdung sbyang dang nyams dga' ba'i spyod pa sna tshogs byas pas/ grag pa rnams kyi bdug pa'i spyod pa sna tshogs byed zhing snang*/ grag pa 'ga' zhig gis ras chung gi spyod pa go bzlogs 'di 'dra byed zer nas 'thab pa yang byung*/ de'i dus su du ma ro gcig gi rtogs pa mthar phyin pa yin gsung*/

'gro mgon bzhugs pa'i dus du/ grogs po greg sa smad na 'dong phu bla mchod byed zer nas de 'thad snyam nas/ 'gro mgon la zhus pa'i dus su/ sa smad na ma 'gro mi mi khams shin tu nag pas bar chod 'ong dogs yod gsung*/ 'gro mgon sku gshags nas zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi nyin par shar na 'gro snyam nas/ bla ma dge 'dun rnams kyis ma 'gro gsung na zla ba ngo lnga'i nyin par bung bu gcig la dpe ca bkal nas shar me 'dor la 'gro ba yin gsung*/ de'i dus su rgyal khams mang po la ltad mo lta 'gro snyam nas yid phyogs med du btang ba'i dus su/ smar shod ston pa'i rtsa na byon nas/ sbas kar ma bas rim 'gro dang tshogs mchod mang du byas pa'i dus su/ 'gro mgon yab sras la sogs pa bka' brgyud rnams byon nas/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ gar yang ma 'gro la sa cha 'di nyid du sgoms dang rang don dang gzhan don gnyis ka 'byung ba yin gsung*/ de nas se ko dgon par chags phabs pa'i dus su/ rtsol sgrub med par 'phrin las bzhi la mnga' mnyes pa dang*/ snyan pa phyog med du khyab pa dang*/ longs spyod char bab pa bzhin du 'byung gsung*/ se ko dgon pa na lo bcu drug bzhugs pa'i dus su yon tan gtor rdzogs pa yin gsung*/ dag pa'i snang ba las 'dzam bu gling mthong ba dang*/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs dang*/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i lha tshogs lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ rigs lnga'i lha tshogs dang*/ phyags na rdo rje dang gsang sngags rnying ma'i he ru ka yang mang po'i lha tshogs dang rdo rje phag mo'i lha tshogs mang po dang*/ chos skyong ma mgon gyi rnam 'phrul mang po dang*/ mthong snang dpag tu med pa yod de brjod kyis mi lang bas dgos pa med gsung*/ de dang po sha 'bom na mjal ba'i dus su/ mchod chung khyod gang nas 'ongs pa yin gsung*/ nged sa stod nas 'ongs pa yin da dbus su 'gro ba yin byas tsa/

khyed nga'i gdul bya gcig a ma yin bas/ gar yang ma 'gro sdod gsung*/ de nub shes rab blo gros pas dbang bskur zhus pa'i gral du khrid nas thugs la btags pa byung nas/ de nub dbang bskur tshogs pa'i rjes la rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ do nub khyod 'dug pa'i thad so na/ dus gsum mkhyen pa dang bka' brgyud kun gsal/ khyod las can cig e ma yin gsung*/ de nas so ko dgon pa la 'ong ba'i dus su/ se ko dang zho ko gnyis kyi bar sgad shel mur 'og ni 'gyul na phyin ba'i dus su/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ de ring de dus gsum khyen pa'i snang ba nam mkha' gang ba gcig byung*/ da khyod skal ldan gcig yin par 'dug pas gar yang ma 'gro bar nga'i chos 'dug 'di gyis gsung*/ mngon par shes pa rgya chen po mnga' bar 'dug ste/ shin tu gsang bar 'dug /de'i dus su rin po che ska thog kyi chos rje gtsang ston pa de snyan pa shin tu che bar 'dug pa nyi ma snga dro gcig gi dus su/ ska thog pa ngos su 'dug pa gda' na 'di pa ci 'dra yin snyam nas dgongs pa btangs ba'i dus su/ sprin med pa'i nam mkha' 'dra ba'i 'od sngon po 'dra ba'i gzhal khang rgya che ba gcig gi dbus su/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa rang bzhin gyi gsal/ khong bzhugs pa'i thad so de na 'od zer kha tog sna lnga'i phung po bsam gyi mi khyab pa gcig snang ba byung gsung*/ 'di pa sangs rgyas yin par dgongs nas/ de'i nub mo tshogs mchod cig kyang mdzad pa'i dus su/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i he ru ka mang po yang zhal gzigs pa byung gsungs/ do nub kyi rmi lam du rin po che sna tshogs las grubs pa'i ri bsam gyi khyab pa cig gi ngos thams cad sman rnam pa sna tshogs pa skye bar 'dug /'od sngon po de'i gzhal yas khang de'i dbus su bla ma ska thog pa rang 'od kyi rang bzhin du bzhugs pa snang*/ dung kar chen po cig 'bud mi med par rang grag du grags pa las/

dung dpag tu med pa che ba de la 'phro zhing phyogs med rang grag du ti ri ri 'gro ba gcig rmis/ khong gi snyan pa phyog med du grag pa'i brdar ru 'dug /de nas phyi de lo ska thog la byon nas/ rin po che ska thog pa la dbang bskur zhus pa'i dus su/ khong thug dam rdzogs pa chen po la mnyam par bzhugs pa'i dus su yun ring po cig la mi snang ba gcig byung*/ nub gnyis la zhi khro lha tshogs ma lus pa zhal gzigs pa yin gsung*/ mkhyen pa ye shes phyogs med du rgyas pa de nas byung ba yin gsung*/ de nas khra po rag sna la byon nas dgon pa bzung ba'i dus su/ shar phyogs su sangs rgyas mi 'khrug pa dpag tu med pa'i zhal mthong ba yin gsung*/ tshogs mchod kyi dus su gtor ma khol ba dang*/ bdud rtsi gyur ba dang sman gyi ri lu phun sum tshogs pas tshogs chang gang ba dang*/ mthong snang dpag tu med pa dang gnam gyi skar ma tsam 'dra ba dang*/ khyad par du dus gsum mkhyen pa kha dog du mar snang ba dpag tu med pa mthong gsung*/ skyungs dgon pa nas zhabs ma bde ba'i dus su/ grub pa thob tshad kyi bla ma kun zhal gzigs khyad par 'gro mgon ras chen yi zhal nas/ skye ba med la mnyam rjes med// na tsha bsdug bsngal 'khrul pa ste// skye 'chi 'jigs na sgom chen min gsung*/ de phyin chad mnyam rjes 'brel ba yin gsung*/ de nas sa stod yul ma bde nas smar khams sgang la byon pa'i dus su/ zhag 'ga' sku khams ma bde nas/ de nas yar bde ba'i dus su nged sbung ri nas tshur 'ongs nas zhabs tog dang rim 'gro dang yun ring du byas pa'i dus su/ rin po che'i zhal nas da lo nad 'dis res cig bde yang lar mi bde ba yin/ khyed rang shar phyogs la ma 'gro dgon pa zungs 'phrin las rlabs po che gyis/ nga 'chi ba'i dus su khye rang kun 'gro sa yod pa gyis 'dir yang ma sdod gsung*/ 'gro mgon gyi zhal nas nga la yang yang khyod smar shod khams kyi phyogs su ma 'gro gsung*/

zhing khams mi dag pa yin ba la/ 'dir glo bur 'ong dgos red pas de la bar chad 'di rnams byung ba yin gsung*/ bla ma'i bka' bcags pa lan pa yin/ kha rtsang smar khams sgo shod la phyin ba'i nub mo 'gro mgon ras pa thugs ma mnyes sin ba rmis/ nga da res cis kyang 'gro dgos par 'dug gsung*/ ngas dus gsum mkhyen pa yab sras kyi bstan pa'i zhabs tog bya snyam tsa/ nga'i ring la rgya chen po ma grub/ khyed kyi ring la rgya che po 'byung bar 'dug pas/ mtshur phu mas chos rje dus gsum mkhyen pa yab sras kyi bstan pa 'di khyod kyi khur rgyu yin bas thugs rgya ma chung gsung khyed 'di nas skye ba gar bltam zhus pa las/ bar do med par skad cig gis lag pa brkyang bskum gcig gi bar la/ mgon po byams pa dang dga' ldan gyi snang ba shar ba yin bas/ lha'i lo 'ga' la ting nge 'dzin bskyangs nas sa bcu'i mgon por 'byung ba yin gsung*/ de nas sangs rgyas pa la dga' ldan na tsheg med gsung*/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul mang po phyogs med du 'gyed cing gdul bya thams cad drang ba yin gsungs/ khyed bu slob rnams ci byed gar snang lha'i spyan gyi mthong ba yin bas/ khyod kyi bu slob rnams kyi smin grol yang byed pa yin gsung*/ nga dang mgon po byams pa la lhan du dga' ldan du gsol ba thob gsung*/ nga'i rnam 'phrul gcig rgya gar kar ti ka na dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rnam 'phrul de'i rgyal mtshan du dbang bskul nas/ gdan sa yun ring du byed cing smin grol gyi lam la bkod par 'dug gsung*// de la sogs pa 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gsum gyi mkhyen pa dag snang dpag tu med pa mnga' bar 'dug ste/ rtings cung zad tsam bkod pa la rin po che la zhus pa/ nga la khyed kyi 'phrin las tsam byung na rab ste/ de bas che e 'ong zhus pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ slob dpon bas slob ma 'phrin las che ba yod pa yin/

nga yan chod bka' brgyud kun kyi 'phrin las dang bstan pa khyod la brten te 'ong bar 'dug /bu slob skal ldan mang po 'byung bar 'dug /grags pa rin chen 'di nga'i skye ba gsum gyi slob ma dang yon bdag yin par 'dug ste khos ma bsgoms g.yeng ba che ba yin ba'i phyir/ da rung skye ba 'gar 'gro ba 'dren pa mi 'byung bar 'dug /de la sogs pa bu slob rnams kyi 'brel tshul bsam gyi mi khyab pa gcig gsungs te/ 'dir ma bkod/ de nas rtag par lta ba ngan pa rnams sun 'don pa dang*/ le lo can rnams dge sbyor la bskul ba'i phyir/ sa ga sa ri rgyal dang phrad pa'i nyin par yongs su mya ngan las 'das tshul bstan nas/ tshes bco lnga nyin par gdung bzhus pa'i bar la/ 'ja' dang sa g.yo ba dang*/ 'od la sogs pa dpag tu med pa byung*/ byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa'i rtags su/ sku gdung ring bsrel dpag tu med pa byon/ gsung gi dbang phyug brnyes pa'i rtags su ljags byon/ rnam par mi rtogs mthar phyin ba'i rtags su/ thug byon pa la sogs pa'i rten dpag tu med pa byon/ ya mtshan rmad du byung ba 'gro ba 'dren ba'i chos rje'i mdzad pa bsam gyi mi khyab// bstan pa'i gtso dang dbyer med pas// rnam thar cung zad bkod pa yis// bstan pa yun ring gnas par shog /bla ma rin po che pong rag pa'i rnam thar gsal byed mkha' la nyi ma shar ba bzhin rin chen sgron ma zhes bya ba rdzogs so/// /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa'i/ skal ldan rang byung rdo rje mi brjed gzungs su bkod pa'o// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling brgyan du shog /pu nya badz+rī rnam thar 'di/ sa ta sarba ma lus pas/ brad nya ma ha yi don rtogs nas/ dhar du dzña bhud ha thob par shog// /
